headline: What Could Push ADSK Stock Higher From Here?
summary: Five years ago, Autodesk spent about $1.8 billion on a string of construction acquisitions. That bet has now compounded into a business generating almost $600 million in annual revenue. This segment is still growing north of 20%, a rate faster than the company average.

headline: 1 Mid-Cap Stock to Target This Week and 2 We Question
summary: Many investors pay attention to mid-cap stocks because they have established business models and expansive market opportunities. However, their paths to becoming $100 billion corporations are ripe with competition, ranging from giants with vast resources to agile upstarts eager to disrupt the status quo.
